note: device rows: the engine's kernel state of world 0 read every SAMPLE ticks (each controller step, at the step's edge, before that edge's command) by a read-only tap, reduced over each frame window (mean of the samples unless the name or 'reducers' says otherwise). Unlike the scenario file's records (every 1 us tick), these are samples every 10 us.

xt.note: rise above the base temperature, K, split by heat source: the engine's thermal lag states of each ring (and monitor PD) observer, read at every controller edge (10 us) and averaged over the frame; groups: the ring's own heater, own absorbed light, own junction + driver, the other rings' heaters, light and junctions + drivers, and the aggressor sites

reducers.heater.step_max_codes: max |register change| between consecutive controller steps
reducers.pd.i_signal_ua / i_dark_na / noise / ful: from the frame means of the records through the model's PD law and ADC transfer

key.note: selfheat_loop_gain: Z_opt,self(0) x dP_abs/dT_ring at the key frame (phase model + exact ring at every line, light at the ring held): below 1 the ring's own heating is stable at this point. ring_rise_by_source_k [frame][ring][source]: the ring's temperature rise above the base split by heat source: the sum of the engine's thermal lag states of that ring observer, grouped by the lag's source (exact: the observer is the base plus the sum of its lags, mrm.plant.thermal.thermal_outputs_b). pd_rise_by_source_k: the same for each monitor PD.

units.laser.f_dev_mhz: MHz from the nominal grid frequency
